message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023, based on the federal holidays that fall on weekdays (or are observed on weekdays when they land on a weekend).  
*(Note: Some provinces have additional holidays or observe the same holiday on a different date – see the footnotes for details.)*

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span (inclusive) | Observed (if applicable) |
|---------|-----------|-------------|--------------------------------|--------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 | Mon | Jan 1–3 (Mon‑Wed) | — |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, AB, NB, PEI, SK) | Feb 20 | Mon | Feb 18–20 (Sat‑Mon) | — |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 | Fri | Apr 7–9 (Fri‑Sun) | — |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 | Mon | May 20–22 (Sat‑Mon) | — |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 | Sat | Jul 1–3 (Sat‑Mon) | Observed Jul 3 (Mon) |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 | Mon | Sep 2–4 (Sat‑Mon) | — |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 | Mon | Oct 7–9 (Sat‑Mon) | — |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 | Fri | Nov 10–12 (Thu‑Sat) | Observed Nov 10 (Thu) |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 | Mon | Dec 25–27 (Mon‑Wed) | — |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 | Tue | Dec 26–28 (Tue‑Thu) | — |

### How to read the table
* **Long‑Weekend Span** – The period that includes the holiday plus the adjacent weekend days.  
  * If the holiday falls on a Monday, the long weekend is the holiday plus the following two days (Mon‑Wed).  
  * If the holiday falls on a Friday, the long weekend is the holiday plus the preceding two days (Fri‑Sun).  
  * If the holiday falls on a weekend, the observed weekday is used to determine the long weekend (e.g., Canada Day is observed on Monday Jul 3, so the long weekend is Jul 1–3).  

### Provincial variations
| Province | Additional/Alternate Holiday | 2023 Date | Long‑Weekend Span |
|----------|------------------------------|-----------|-------------------|
| British Columbia | Family Day | Feb 20 | Feb 18–20 |
| Manitoba | Louis Riel Day | Feb 20 | Feb 18–20 |
| Saskatchewan | Family Day | Feb 20 | Feb 18–20 |
| Alberta | Family Day | Feb 20 | Feb 18–20 |
| New Brunswick | Family Day | Feb 20 | Feb 18–20 |
| Prince Edward Island | Family Day | Feb 20 | Feb 18–20 |
| Ontario | Family Day | Feb 20 | Feb 18–20 |
| Quebec | Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day | Jun 24 | Jun 22–24 |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 | Mar 15–17 |
| Nova Scotia | Family Day | Feb 20 | Feb 18–20 |
| Yukon | Family Day | Feb 20 | Feb 18–20 |
| Northwest Territories | Family Day | Feb 20 | Feb 18–20 |
| Nunavut | Family Day | Feb 20 | Feb 18–20 |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> • Store the holiday dates in a database or JSON file.  
> • Use a simple lookup to flag any date that falls within a long‑weekend span.  
> • Consider adding a “province” field so users can filter holidays relevant to their location.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in a specific format (CSV, JSON, etc.) or if you need the full list of provincial holidays for each region.
